categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Matches the 'Wallet' area label and modifies Berkeley DB cursor stream handling (`BerkeleyROCursor::Next()`) used during legacy wallet loading and migration.
categories.rationale: Fixes a bug where `migratewallet` falsely rejects valid legacy Berkeley DB wallets as corrupt due to stream contamination across records. The wallet rubric places migration correctness and the legacy-to-descriptor path directly after fund safety; leaving valid wallets unable to migrate due to residual bytes in reused stream buffers is a critical reliability failure.
